name: Synthetic Sciences
long_description: We’re building infrastructure for scientific superintelligence. We develop high-fidelity evaluations and RL environments for long-horizon scientific research, alongside post-training systems and reinforcement-learning methods designed for domains where verification is slow, expensive, and imperfect. We’re starting with ML research, building agents that can form hypotheses, run experiments, learn from failures, and make meaningful progress over long horizons.
